{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Unit Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 2.x
  pull_request: ~

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  SYMFONY_DEPRECATIONS_HELPER: weak

jobs:
  unit-test:
    name: Unit ( PHP ${{ matrix.php }} )
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: "actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1" # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: "shivammathur/setup-php@eb7c497e18156a6bbabfef1d3a82760b9eda3962" # v2.40.0
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: intl, opcache, mysql, pdo_mysql
          coverage: none

      - name: Cache composer dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: "ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda" # v4.0.0

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit

  bc:
    name: BC with 1.x
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: "actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1" # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: "shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240" # v2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: '8.1'
          extensions: intl, soap
          coverage: none

      - name: Cache composer dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: "ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda" # v4.0.0

      # A failure here is a break with 1.x, not a test to update. See src/Payum/Core/Tests/Bc/README.md.
      - name: Run the BC suite
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite bc

  lowest:
    name: Unit ( PHP ${{ matrix.php }} + Lowest )
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: "actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1" # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: "shivammathur/setup-php@eb7c497e18156a6bbabfef1d3a82760b9eda3962" # v2.40.0
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: intl, opcache, mysql, pdo_mysql
          coverage: none

      - name: Cache composer dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: "ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda" # v4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: "lowest"

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit

  doctrine-migrations:
    name: Doctrine migrations ( ${{ matrix.database }} + ${{ matrix.dependencies }} )
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        database: ['postgres', 'mysql', 'mariadb']
        dependencies: ['highest', 'lowest']
        include:
          - database: postgres
            image: 'postgres:17'
            port: 5432
            url: 'pdo_pgsql://payum:payum@127.0.0.1:5432/payum'
            health: 'pg_isready -U payum'
          - database: mysql
            image: 'mysql:8.4'
            port: 3306
            url: 'pdo_mysql://root:payum@127.0.0.1:3306/payum'
            health: 'mysqladmin ping -ppayum'
          - database: mariadb
            image: 'mariadb:11'
            port: 3306
            url: 'pdo_mysql://root:payum@127.0.0.1:3306/payum'
            health: 'healthcheck.sh --connect --innodb_initialized'

    services:
      database:
        image: ${{ matrix.image }}
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: payum
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: payum
          POSTGRES_DB: payum
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: payum
          MYSQL_DATABASE: payum
          MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD: payum
          MARIADB_DATABASE: payum
        ports:
          - ${{ matrix.port }}:${{ matrix.port }}
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "${{ matrix.health }}"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 20

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: "actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1" # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: "shivammathur/setup-php@eb7c497e18156a6bbabfef1d3a82760b9eda3962" # v2.40.0
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: intl, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql
          coverage: none

      - name: Cache composer dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: "ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda" # v4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: ${{ matrix.dependencies }}

      - name: Run the migration tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit src/Payum/Core/Tests/Functional/Bridge/Doctrine/Migrations
        env:
          PAYUM_DOCTRINE_TEST_URL: ${{ matrix.url }}

  mongodb:
    name: Unit ( PHP ${{ matrix.php }} + MongoDB ${{ matrix.mongodb }} + ext-mongodb ${{ matrix.driver }}.x )
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']
        mongodb: ['8.0']
        driver: ['2']
        include:
          # Server compatibility is a property of ext-mongodb / doctrine-odm rather
          # than of the PHP version, so older servers only need one PHP version.
          - php: '8.1'
            mongodb: '6.0'
            driver: '2'
          - php: '8.1'
            mongodb: '7.0'
            driver: '2'
          # ext-mongodb 1.x is still widely deployed, and Composer resolves it to a
          # different mongodb/mongodb major, so keep one job on the latest 1.x.
          - php: '8.1'
            mongodb: '8.0'
            driver: '1'

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: "actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1" # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: "shivammathur/setup-php@eb7c497e18156a6bbabfef1d3a82760b9eda3962" # v2.40.0
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: intl, opcache, mysql, pdo_mysql, mongodb-${{ matrix.driver }}
          coverage: none

      # mongod 8.0 refuses to start on Linux 6.19 to 7.0.13 kernels, which some runners have
      # (SERVER-121912). Handing rseq back to glibc keeps it out of the way.
      - name: Start MongoDB
        uses: "supercharge/mongodb-github-action@89d1ecb837145f486898e235478a7e267f68c44e" # main, for mongodb-extra-env
        with:
          mongodb-version: ${{ matrix.mongodb }}
          mongodb-extra-env: GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.pthread.rseq=1

      - name: Cache composer dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: "ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda" # v4.0.0

      - name: Install Doctrine Mongodb ODM
        run: composer require doctrine/mongodb-odm --with-all-dependencies

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs composer-install in every job with no dependency cache, so packages are re-downloaded on each run. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads) applies: repeated dependency fetching is measurable, and the cache input is the pinned composer.lock plus runner OS. Adding an actions/cache step for ~/.composer/cache/files keyed by hashFiles('composer.lock') before each install preserves all build/test coverage, requires no new secrets, permissions, or network access, and matches the measured benefit seen in the comparable experiment (adding a dependency cache to a test workflow).",

}

```yaml
name: Unit Tests

on:

      - 2.x

permissions:

env:

jobs:
  unit-test:
    name: Unit ( PHP ${{ matrix.php }} )
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: "actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1" # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: "shivammathur/setup-php@eb7c497e18156a6bbabfef1d3a82760b9eda3962" # v2.40.0
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: intl, opcache, mysql, pdo_mysql
          coverage: none

        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: "ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda" # v4.0.0

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit

  bc:
    name: BC with 1.x
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: "actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1" # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: "shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240" # v2.37.2
        with:
          php-version: '8.1'
          extensions: intl, soap
          coverage: none

      - name: Cache composer dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: "ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda" # v4.0.0

      # A failure here is a break with 1.x, not a test to update. See src/Payum/Core/Tests/Bc/README.md.
      - name: Run the BC suite
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite bc

  lowest:
    name: Unit ( PHP ${{ matrix.php }} + Lowest )
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: "actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1" # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: "shivammathur/setup-php@eb7c497e18156a6bbabfef1d3a82760b9eda3962" # v2.40.0
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: intl, opcache, mysql, pdo_mysql
          coverage: none

      - name: Cache composer dependencies

        with:

          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}

        uses: "ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda" # v4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: "lowest"

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit

  doctrine-migrations:
    name: Doctrine migrations ( ${{ matrix.database }} + ${{ matrix.dependencies }} )
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        database: ['postgres', 'mysql', 'mariadb']
        dependencies: ['highest', 'lowest']
        include:
          - database: postgres
            image: 'postgres:17'
            port: 5432
            url: 'pdo_pgsql://payum:payum@127.0.0.1:5432/payum'
            health: 'pg_isready -U payum'
          - database: mysql
            image: 'mysql:8.4'
            port: 3306
            url: 'pdo_mysql://root:payum@127.0.0.1:3306/payum'
            health: 'mysqladmin ping -ppayum'
          - database: mariadb
            image: 'mariadb:11'
            port: 3306
            url: 'pdo_mysql://root:payum@127.0.0.1:3306/payum'
            health: 'healthcheck.sh --connect --innodb_initialized'

    services:
      database:
        image: ${{ matrix.image }}
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: payum
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: payum
          POSTGRES_DB: payum
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: payum
          MYSQL_DATABASE: payum
          MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD: payum
          MARIADB_DATABASE: payum
        ports:
          - ${{ matrix.port }}:${{ matrix.port }}
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "${{ matrix.health }}"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 20

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: "actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1" # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: "shivammathur/setup-php@eb7c497e18156a6bbabfef1d3a82760b9eda3962" # v2.40.0
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: intl, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql
          coverage: none

      - name: Cache composer dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: "ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda" # v4.0.0
        with:
          dependency-versions: ${{ matrix.dependencies }}

      - name: Run the migration tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit src/Payum/Core/Tests/Functional/Bridge/Doctrine/Migrations
        env:
          PAYUM_DOCTRINE_TEST_URL: ${{ matrix.url }}

  mongodb:
    name: Unit ( PHP ${{ matrix.php }} + MongoDB ${{ matrix.mongodb }} + ext-mongodb ${{ matrix.driver }}.x )
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']
        mongodb: ['8.0']
        driver: ['2']
        include:
          # Server compatibility is a property of ext-mongodb / doctrine-odm rather
          # than of the PHP version, so older servers only need one PHP version.
          - php: '8.1'
            mongodb: '6.0'
            driver: '2'
          - php: '8.1'
            mongodb: '7.0'
            driver: '2'
          # ext-mongodb 1.x is still widely deployed, and Composer resolves it to a
          # different mongodb/mongodb major, so keep one job on the latest 1.x.
          - php: '8.1'
            mongodb: '8.0'
            driver: '1'

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: "actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1" # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: "shivammathur/setup-php@eb7c497e18156a6bbabfef1d3a82760b9eda3962" # v2.40.0
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: intl, opcache, mysql, pdo_mysql, mongodb-${{ matrix.driver }}
          coverage: none

      # mongod 8.0 refuses to start on Linux 6.19 to 7.0.13 kernels, which some runners have
      # (SERVER-121912). Handing rseq back to glibc keeps it out of the way.
      - name: Start MongoDB
        uses: "supercharge/mongodb-github-action@89d1ecb837145f486898e235478a7e267f68c44e" # main, for mongodb-extra-env
        with:
          mongodb-version: ${{ matrix.mongodb }}
          mongodb-extra-env: GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.pthread.rseq=1

      - name: Cache composer dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: "ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda" # v4.0.0

      - name: Install Doctrine Mongodb ODM
        run: composer require doctrine/mongodb-odm --with-all-dependencies

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit
```
